_comment: Maps internal attribution field names to the GHL custom field 'fieldKey' holding each value on a Matama Floors Contact. These are the CONVENTIONAL defaults — they must be checked against the real Matama GHL sub-account once it exists, since custom field keys are set per-location and may differ. Attribution only works if the landing page captures fbclid/utm_* into these fields AND each Meta ad set's URL parameters stamp Meta's dynamic IDs: utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=paid&utm_campaign={{campaign.id}}&utm_content={{ad.id}}&utm_term={{adset.id}}
